summary: Iteration 52 Phase 9A Meta Strategy Engine + Portfolio Risk Layer - Testing completed with 20/21 backend tests passed (1 skipped), Admin UI pages fully functional

integration_issues.issue: New test user registration followed by admin approval and login flow returns 400 error. May be timing issue or approval not completing correctly.
integration_issues.note: Backend APIs for user approval work correctly via API (tested in pytest). UI flow may need investigation.

critical_code_review_comments: Admin Strategy Allocation page correctly shows all strategy states (ACTIVE/THROTTLED/DISABLED) with editable fields
Admin Portfolio Risk page displays limits registry, cluster configuration, and exposure breakdown correctly

Meta strategy engine recalculates strategy drift based on signal_decay/execution_quality_score/performance_score - admin can set DISABLED state with disabled_lock, but THROTTLED state may be recalculated based on metrics
UserExecutePage has Portfolio Risk Impact panel and Meta Strategy Attribution panel with correct data-testid attributes
UserSignalsPage and UserTradesPage both display strategy_weight, allocation_source, and meta_engine_decision columns
seed_data_creation: Test created risk cluster L3_TEST, strategy allocations for throttled_test_strategy, disabled_test_strategy, test_strategy_state
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 9A meta strategy engine and portfolio risk layer fully implemented and tested. Backend APIs: GET/PUT /api/admin/portfolio-risk/limits, GET/POST /api/admin/portfolio-risk/clusters, GET /api/admin/portfolio-risk (dashboard), GET/PUT /api/admin/strategy-allocation - all working. Execution preview returns meta_strategy_summary and portfolio_risk_impact with gate_decision (ALLOW/ADJUST_POSITION/REQUIRE_APPROVAL/REJECT). Admin UI pages at /admin/strategy-allocation and /admin/portfolio-risk render correctly.

phase9a_verified_features.admin_portfolio_risk_limits_api: GET/PUT working - can read and update max_portfolio_leverage, max_symbol_exposure, max_cluster_exposure, max_strategy_exposure, max_single_trade_risk, max_intraday_drawdown, max_total_drawdown
phase9a_verified_features.admin_portfolio_risk_clusters_api: GET/POST working - can list clusters (L1, L2, L3_TEST) and create/update clusters with cluster_id, symbols, cluster_type, correlation_score, risk_weight
phase9a_verified_features.admin_portfolio_risk_dashboard_api: GET working - returns total_exposure, cluster_exposure, strategy_exposure, drawdown_monitor, risk_alerts
phase9a_verified_features.admin_strategy_allocation_api: GET/PUT working - can list and update strategy allocations with capital_weight, max_capital, current_capital, state (ACTIVE/THROTTLED/DISABLED), confidence_score, performance_score, signal_decay, execution_quality_score
phase9a_verified_features.execution_preview_meta_strategy: Returns meta_strategy_summary with strategy_id, meta_engine_decision, allocation_source, strategy_allocation_reason, strategy_weight, state
phase9a_verified_features.execution_preview_portfolio_risk: Returns portfolio_risk_impact with risk_score, risk_flags, decision, cluster_id, current_portfolio_leverage, symbol_exposure_pct, cluster_exposure_pct, strategy_exposure_pct, single_trade_risk_pct
phase9a_verified_features.user_signals_strategy_attribution: Frontend displays strategy_weight, allocation_source, meta_engine_decision columns
phase9a_verified_features.user_trades_strategy_attribution: Frontend displays strategy_weight, allocation_source, meta_engine_decision columns with decision trace panel
phase9a_verified_features.admin_strategy_allocation_page: UI renders at /admin/strategy-allocation with strategy table showing all allocation metrics and state dropdown
phase9a_verified_features.admin_portfolio_risk_page: UI renders at /admin/portfolio-risk with total exposure, risk alerts, limits registry, cluster table, exposure breakdown
